errors.undoBlocked: This cannot be undone: another import touched the same assets or the position was edited afterwards.

errors.modelUnreadable: We could not read this file. Try a sharper image or the PDF file.

errors.modelPositionsWithoutPrice: We read the positions, but the prices are not legible, and without a price we cannot record the cost. Send a screenshot that shows the price or a brokerage note.
